detail.readme:
The world’s software. Rebuilt, and open-sourced.

English · 简体中文 · Español

The Everything Project is an effort to rebuild and open-source the world’s software from scratch. From Office to Slack and Photoshop to AutoCAD, we are recreating free, open-source alternatives to all proprietary software. This is a mono-repository containing all the applications and tools developed under the project. [Office](#office) · [Collaboration](#collaboration) · [Creative Tools](#creative-tools) · [Engineering](#engineering) · [Productivity](#productivity) · [Finance](#finance) · [Business](#business) · [Developer Tools](#developer-tools) · [Games](#games)
## Getting started Requires Node.js 22.12 or newer. ```sh git clone https://github.com/HeyPuter/everything.git cd everything/src/[app-name] npm install npm run dev ```

detail.readme_zh:
全世界的软件，从零重建，全部开源。

English · 简体中文 · Español

Everything 项目致力于从零开始重建全世界的软件，并将其全部开源。从 Office 到 Slack，从 Photoshop 到 AutoCAD，我们正在为所有专有软件打造免费、开源的替代品。本仓库是一个单一代码仓库（monorepo），包含该项目开发的所有应用和工具。 [办公](#办公) · [协作](#协作) · [创意工具](#创意工具) · [工程](#工程) · [效率](#效率) · [财务](#财务) · [商业](#商业) · [开发者工具](#开发者工具) · [游戏](#游戏)
